Can’t believe there are still ppl who think crochet clothes look ugly when I think they’re some of the most beautiful pieces ever 😤 The fact that they can’t be made by machines makes each crochet piece feel so much more soulful and special! 🥹 If you’re trying to level up ur crochet game, here are some of my tips: 1. Opt for smaller yarn sizes! I started with size 4 Aran yarn, and now I literally never touch anything thicker than DK 🫢 Thicker yarn creates bulkier pieces! 2. Experiment with different fibers & ditch those milk cotton yarns 😩 Not trying to be a hater, but my milk cotton clothes are all too hot and stiff 🫠 Try plant-fiber yarns for a more airy result, or acrylic blends for something lighter! 3. Practice, practice, practice! Tension and hook choices matter too, so keep experimenting until you find what works for you~ What do you think? Replying to @AZTbreak97 Here it is🤗 Pattern by CelestialCB (I couldn’t find them on TikTok so this is their Etsy shop name) Modifications I made: - R8, crochet the arms while making this round, I made 19chs instead of 18 and went into the 4th ch from the hook instead of the 3rd to make the hands - Added an extra round of sc - On the closing round, I crocheted a leg (same as arms), sl st through both sides, made the other leg on the second to last stitch to close, and finally connected the leg in the last stitch (on both sides) with a sl st #crochetersoftiktok #amigurumi #craftersoftiktok #crochet #handmade #frog #crochetideas #crochetpattern
